title: City station readings (hourly), Environment Monitoring Unit
summary: Hourly NO2 (ug/m3) and PM2.5 (ug/m3) readings from the city's own monitoring stations, keyed by station code and UTC hour start. Catalog lists about 4.2 million rows and an hourly refresh, last refreshed 2026-10-14. Coverage starts 2023-01-01 and is open-ended; it cannot serve the 2004-2005 prototype window. Station VR-03 (Via Roma) stopped reporting on 2024-06-30 according to the wiki.

documentation_excerpts: Catalog description: 'Hourly NO2 and PM2.5 readings from the city's own monitoring stations.'
Wiki station_network (last_edited 2024-07-01): 'Station VR-03 (Via Roma) was switched off on 2024-06-30. Its readings stop there.'
Wiki station_network: '`airq.station_readings` still lists the network as active. Station VR-03 has no readings after 2024-06-30.'
Wiki station_network: 'The other stations report continuously from 2023-01-01.'
quality_notes: Catalog vs wiki: catalog temporal_coverage start 2023-01-01 (open-ended end); wiki station_network (2024-07-01) confirms other stations continuous from 2023-01-01, so the start date is consistent.

Catalog vs wiki: catalog status 'active' and the network is described as active, but wiki (2024-07-01) says station VR-03 stopped on 2024-06-30. Production window 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31 therefore has a gap for VR-03 from 2024-06-30 onward (about 18 months of that station's data missing if it is used).
Prototype window 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 is entirely outside coverage; this source cannot serve N1 for the prototype window.
No hourly traffic, temperature or humidity fields: this source meets N1 only. Needs N2, N3 must be sourced elsewhere.
PM2.5 measurement method, unit validation flags and data-quality status are not documented; no flag column is listed.
Catalog last_refreshed 2026-10-14 (refresh_cadence hourly) is recent relative to as_of 2026-10-15; timeliness is consistent with the declared cadence but was not verified against data.
Station metadata (locations, coordinates, district) is not in the catalog entry, so joins to traffic counters by distance cannot be done from this entry alone.
Not sampled: internal source, no data file was read; row count and null patterns are unverified.
